verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs explicitly state agents can load tools from remote MCP servers to expand capabilities (mastra-docs-3), directly matching the story of plugging in MCP servers to use their tools. This is corroborated by first-party framework design (agents/tools architecture) though independent hands-on confirmation of MCP client usage specifically is thin. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on verification of consuming external MCP servers, and more detail on configuration/auth for remote MCP connections.
